question: In the sentence 'The explanation provided by the professor was succinct', what is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'succinct'?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Long-winded**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**succinct**" means brief and clearly expressed. (संक्षिप्त)
 
• The antonym of "succinct" is "**Long-winded**," which means using too many words or being overly verbose. (लंबा-चौड़ा या शब्दy)
 
• The other options: "**Laconic**," "**Pithy**," and "**Concise**" are synonyms of "succinct" and do not fit the context as an antonym.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The explanation provided by the professor was succinct__, unlike the long-winded explanations given by others.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Laconic (मितभाषी)**: means using very few words.
 
• **Pithy (सारगर्भित)**: means concise and full of meaning.
 
• **Concise (संक्षिप्त)**: means giving a lot of information clearly and briefly.
